category_edits.rationale: Test bounded training-frequency midrank percentiles instead of standardized log counts across all four category models. Preserve padding and mask scales at 1; the existing checkpoint buffer and predictor retain the computed scales without architecture changes.

edits.find:
log_counts = np.log1p(training_counts[1:itemnum + 1])
    standardized_counts = (log_counts - log_counts.mean()) / max(float(log_counts.std()), 1e-6)
    input_scales = 1.0 + 0.02 * np.tanh(standardized_counts)
edits.replace:
real_counts = training_counts[1:itemnum + 1]
    _, count_inverse, tie_counts = np.unique(
        real_counts, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True
    )
    midpoint_percentiles = (
        np.cumsum(tie_counts, dtype=np.float64) - 0.5 * tie_counts
    ) / float(itemnum)
    frequency_percentiles = midpoint_percentiles[count_inverse]
    input_scales = 1.0 + 0.02 * (2.0 * frequency_percentiles - 1.0)

change_summary: Replace log-frequency modulation with tie-aware frequency percentile modulation using training interactions only. Existing checkpoint and predictor plumbing remains compatible.
